description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the MultiStageCommand feature within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests various scenarios for retrieving, modifying, and creating 'things' and 'policies' via an actor-based enforcement component, including handling of permissions, errors, and timeout conditions.

classes.name: MultiStageCommandTest
classes.description: Unit tests for multi-stage command processing in Eclipse Ditto, focusing on get, modify, and create operations for Things and Policies, with permission and error handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the actor system and mock actors before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test.

methods.name: retrieveThingAndPolicy
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Thing and its Policy, verifying correct inline policy inclusion.

methods.name: retrieveThingWithoutPolicyWhenPermissionIsMissing
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Thing when the subject lacks permission to access the Policy, verifying the absence of the policy in the response.

methods.name: retrieveThingErrorIfCacheIsOutOfDate
methods.description: Verifies error handling when cached data is out of sync with the actual state.

methods.name: retrieveThingErrorOnTimeout
methods.description: Tests the system's response to timeout scenarios during retrieval.

methods.name: modifyExistingThing
methods.description: Tests modifying an existing Thing and verifies success responses.

methods.name: createThingWithExistingPolicy
methods.description: Tests creating a Thing when the Policy already exists.

methods.name: createThingAndPolicy
methods.description: Tests creating both a Thing and its Policy when neither exists.

methods.name: createThingWithPolicyConflict
methods.description: Tests conflict detection when trying to create a Thing with an existing Policy.

methods.name: createThingWithExplicitPolicy
methods.description: Tests creation of a Thing with an explicitly provided Policy.

methods.name: createThingWithExplicitPolicyNotAuthorizedBySelf
methods.description: Verifies that an error is thrown if the subject attempts to create a Policy it isn't authorized for.

methods.name: newEnforcerActor
methods.description: Helper to instantiate the enforcer actor with mock dependencies.

methods.name: newMockEntitiesActor
methods.description: Creates mock actor instances for testing.

methods.name: emptyThing
methods.description: Constructs a placeholder Thing with specified ID and optional Policy ID.

methods.name: defaultPolicy
methods.description: Creates a default Policy object with permissions assigned to the default subject.

methods.name: thingOnlyPolicy
methods.description: Creates a Policy object with permissions assigned only to a non-default subject.
